title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-03 10:31:28 最新章节：第四百八十章 不简单
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
破碎的大陆，破碎的身体，破碎的灵魂。
简陋的房屋挡不住萧瑟的秋风，屋内的长孙望着窗外，满眼秋意。
三天里长孙除了吃饭睡觉就是像现在这样，看着窗外，却又未看窗外：无论窗外发生什么都不能让长孙有一点反应。
来往的人倒也见怪不怪了，在人们看来这只是一个可怜人行可怜事。
可能是久未活动，长孙略显僵硬的转了转头，眼中秋意慢慢退去，恢复了一丝神采，露出一丝疑惑，向窗外多张望了两眼。
“初黎为什么还没有回来。”长孙有些疑惑。
初黎是长孙的小侍女，在人们看来初黎才是那个真正的可怜人，而长孙则是可怜之人必有可恨之处的可怜人。
在长孙张望之时，街上传来了一阵骚乱，嘈杂声渐渐传来。
“小初黎，你就跟本少爷走吧…”一名看起来与长孙年龄相仿，却穿着朴素的少年说道。
还未等少年说完，叫初黎的小丫头就打断了他：“呸，就你还少爷，我家少爷那才叫少爷，我只会跟着我家少爷，你哪来的回哪去。”
被小丫头这么一呛，少年脸一阵红，但当着这么多人面也拿她没办法。最重要的是初黎说完之后反驳的机会都没给他，就头也不回的走了。
少年年轻气盛，丢了什么也不能丢面子，被初黎当着这么多人驳了面子，岂会这样作罢。
“你家少爷？你难道说的是那个叫长孙的可怜虫，哈哈，我没听错吧，就他还能当少爷。”
正往前走的初黎听了这句话，仿佛施了定身术，定在了原地。
少年见有效果心中一阵得意，变本加厉：“你少爷在哪呢，牵出来让我看看啊。哦，我忘了，他已经变成傻子了，哈哈…”
初黎一步一顿的转过身，颤抖的肩膀显示她已经出离了愤怒。
“你再敢侮辱我家少爷，我…”转过身的初黎小脸气的通红，皱着鼻子，喘着粗气，正要不顾一切上去撕咬这个辱骂少爷的混蛋。
“好了初黎，回来吧。”三天未张口的长孙，说了第一句话。这也是破碎的长孙在这个世界说的第一句话。
人们转头看向长孙，一阵惊奇，随后露出早该如此的神色。
在刚才初黎与少年争吵的时候，人们更多是在看长孙。很多人都是一副恨铁不成钢，咬牙切齿的模样。

在长孙与初黎搬过来的三个多月里，这种事情发生了已经不止一次两次。起初长孙都会像疯了一样跟别人拼命，来维护自己可怜的自尊，而每次的结果都是初黎用瘦小的身体背着遍体鳞伤的长孙，磕磕绊绊的回家。
最后一次，长孙竟是把气洒在初黎身上，随后一头撞在墙上，昏迷不醒。
长孙想用这种屈辱的方式来结束自己的生命，但却苦了初黎。
长孙昏迷后，初黎背着他挨家挨户求人救命，但无奈这本就是丽山城的贫民窟，家家都过着食不果腹的生活。
可怜的初黎背着长孙求了整条街无果后，只能落魄的回家。
可能是上天睁眼吧，在初黎没日没夜，寸步不离的照顾了七天后，长孙奇迹般的睁眼了。
但醒来的长孙就和傻了一样只知道吃、喝、发呆，人们气得都说老天瞎了眼让他活了过来。
只有初黎天天兴奋的和兔子一样。
七天没合眼的初黎，嚷嚷着要让大难不死的少爷吃点好的。在接下来的三天里不光没有休息，还干着比平常多出一倍的活。
“好了初黎，回来吧。”这句话恍若惊雷，在初黎耳旁炸响。
如同触电一般，初黎迅速转过身来，泛着红晕的小脸如同闪着光，满满的喜悦从两只眼睛里溢出来。
长孙看着忽然转过身的初黎，玉面冰肤，面容姣好，虽然衣着寒酸，却难遮大家闺秀之气，这一瞬间长孙一阵失神，记忆重叠。
“你为什么叫初黎？”小男孩问。
“因为夫人是在太阳初升，黎明之时捡到的我，所以给取名初黎。夫人说黎明给了我重生，只要有黎明就会有希望……只要初黎在，就要永远跟着少爷。”小女孩天真的话语却深深的烙印在男孩脑海。
男孩是长孙，女孩是初黎。
“只要有黎明就会有希望，只要初黎在，就要永远跟着少爷。”
长孙抬眼望了望西沉的太阳，心想，“是啊，黎明还会到来，希望永远都在……”
这样的一场小小的风波很快便过去了，贫民窟的人们拖着疲惫的身体回到家中。
content_en:
Broken continent, broken body, broken soul.
The simple house cannot block the bleak autumn wind. The eldest grandson in the house looks out the window, his eyes full of autumn.
For three days, the eldest grandson did nothing but eat and sleep, looking out the window, but not at all: no matter what happened outside the window, the eldest grandson could not react at all.
People who come and go are not surprised. In people's eyes, this is just a poor person doing a pitiful thing.
Perhaps because he had not been active for a long time, the eldest grandson turned his head slightly stiffly. The autumn mood in his eyes slowly receded, and he regained a bit of energy. He showed a trace of doubt and looked out the window a few more times.
"Why hasn't Chuli come back yet?" Changsun was a little confused.
Chuli is Changsun's little maid. In people's eyes, Chuli is the real poor person, while Changsun is the pitiful person who must be hateful in a pitiful person.
While Changsun was looking around, there was a commotion on the street, and the noise gradually came.
"Xiao Chuli, just go with me..." said a young man who looked about the same age as his eldest grandson but was dressed simply.
Before the young man could finish speaking, the little girl named Chu Li interrupted him: "Bah, you are the only one who can return the favor to the young master. My young master is called the young master. I will only follow my young master. You will go back to where you came from."
Being choked by the little girl, the boy blushed, but there was nothing he could do to her in front of so many people. The most important thing was that after Chu Li finished speaking, he didn't even give him a chance to refute, so he left without looking back.
The young man was young and energetic, and he could not lose face even if he lost anything. How could he give up after being refuted by Chu Li in front of so many people?
"Your young master? Are you talking about that poor guy named Changsun? Haha, I heard you right. He is the only one who can still be a young master."
When Chu Li, who was walking forward, heard these words, he seemed to have cast a body-fixing spell and froze in place.
Seeing the effect, the young man felt proud, and he became more serious: "Where is your young master? Take it out and let me see. Oh, I forgot, he has become a fool, haha..."
Chu Li turned around step by step, her trembling shoulders showing that she was out of anger.
"If you dare to insult my young master again, I..." Chu Li turned around, her face flushed with anger, her nose wrinkled, and she was breathing heavily. She was about to go up and bite the bastard who insulted the young master at all costs.
"Okay Chuli, come back." Zhangsun, who hadn't opened his mouth for three days, said the first sentence. This was also the first sentence the broken eldest grandson said in this world.
People turned to look at Zhangsun, surprised for a moment, and then showed expressions that should have been the case long ago.
When Chu Li was quarreling with the boy just now, people were more looking at their eldest grandson. Many people look like they hate iron and are gnashing their teeth.
In the more than three months since Changsun and Chuli moved here, this kind of thing has happened more than once or twice. At first, the eldest grandson would fight like crazy to protect his poor self-esteem, but every time Chu Li would stumble home carrying his bruised eldest grandson with his thin body.
The last time, Changsun actually vented his anger on Chuli, then hit his head against the wall and fell unconscious.
Changsun wanted to end his life in this humiliating way, but Chuli suffered a lot.
After the grandson fell into coma, Chuli carried him from house to house asking for help, but he was helpless. This was a slum in Lishan City, and every family lived a life of hunger.
Poor Chu Li had to go home dejected after begging the whole street behind her eldest grandson's back to no avail.
Maybe God opened his eyes. After Chu Li took care of him day and night for seven days, Changsun miraculously opened his eyes.
But when the eldest grandson woke up, he seemed to be stupid and only knew how to eat, drink and be in a daze. People were so angry that they said God was blind and allowed him to come back to life.
Only Chu Li is as excited as Rabbit every day.
Chu Li, who hadn't slept for seven days, clamored to let the young master who survived the disaster eat something good. In the next three days, not only did I have no rest, I also worked twice as much as usual."Okay Chuli, come back." These words were like thunder, exploding in Chuli's ears.
As if being electrocuted, Chu Li turned around quickly, her flushed face seemed to be shining, and full of joy overflowed from her eyes.
The eldest grandson looked at Chu Li, who suddenly turned around. She had a jade face and ice-cold skin, and a beautiful face. Although her clothes were shabby, it could not conceal her ladylike aura. At this moment, the eldest grandson lost consciousness and his memories overlapped.
"Why are you called Chu Li?" the little boy asked.
"Because Madam picked me up at dawn when the sun was rising, she named me Chu Li. Madam said that dawn gave me a new life. As long as there is dawn, there will be hope... As long as Chu Li is around, I will always follow the young master." The innocent words of the little girl were deeply imprinted on the boy's mind.
The boy is the eldest grandson and the girl is Chuli.
"As long as there is dawn, there will be hope. As long as Chu Li is here, I will always follow the young master."
The eldest grandson looked up at the setting sun and thought, "Yes, the dawn will come again, and hope will always be there..."
Such a small storm passed quickly, and the people in the slums dragged their exhausted bodies back home.
